label: Annotation (narration beside the evidence)
description: Narration that lives BESIDE a product window, never on its own slide: a display line (house line-rise entrance, *stars* = color-only accent), optional counting stat numerals, optional chip pile. Dock it left/right of a window in the same frame. Lines with later `at` values SWAP the previous line. size 'label' = the small bold montage label (top-left, parallel structure). Camera anchor: body.

lines.label: [{text: 'Work the idea in *Claude*.', at: 0.3}] -- later lines swap earlier ones at their `at`

text.label: Shorthand for a single line (equivalent to lines: [{text, at: 0.3}])

stats.label: {at, items: [{value: '87,291', label: 'lines removed'}]} -- numerals count up (the only type allowed to perform)

chips.label: {at, items: ['brief','tasks','calendar']} -- muted pill pile (the busywork visual)

theme.label: light (default, ink on light canvas) | dark

exit_at.label: Fade the whole block at this second (e.g. just before a cut)
